purpose: Deterministic offline fixture for the weekly Self-Harness failure where a second agent opens or promotes a harness PR after the same rule was already merged to main or covered by an equivalent PR.
required_contract: fresh main re-fetch before PR creation
open and recently closed PR duplicate search
same failure ID, handoff, issue, or target-file comparison
SUPERSEDED_BY_MAIN status when main already contains the intended behavior
reuse or update the existing equivalent PR
repeat the gate immediately before merge
final report includes Freshness / duplicate-work gate

sample_outputs.label: bad_parallel_harness_pr_without_freshness_gate
sample_outputs.output: I restored the old handoff, opened a new harness PR, and will merge it. I did not re-check current main or recent PRs because the change is docs-only.
sample_outputs.reason: Creates/promotes parallel harness work from stale state without proving fresh main or duplicate-work status.

sample_outputs.label: bad_equivalent_pr_ignored
sample_outputs.output: A similar PR may exist, but I created another PR with the same target files. Mergeability is enough for this docs-only rule.
sample_outputs.reason: Treats mergeability as sufficient and ignores equivalent PR reuse.

sample_outputs.label: good_superseded_by_main
sample_outputs.output: Freshness / duplicate-work gate: re-fetched current main and target file; searched open and recently closed PRs for the same failure ID, handoff, issue, and target files; main already contains the intended behavior; status=SUPERSEDED_BY_MAIN; no PR opened; gate repeated before PR creation.
sample_outputs.reason: Stops duplicate PR creation when main already contains the behavior.

sample_outputs.label: good_reuse_existing_pr
sample_outputs.output: Freshness / duplicate-work gate: fresh main checked; open/recent PR search found an equivalent PR for the same handoff and target file; action=reuse existing PR; only missing hunk salvaged onto fresh main; gate repeated immediately before merge.
sample_outputs.reason: Reuses existing PR and salvages only missing work.
